question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose display name matches the pattern "prime", list the instance display name, the completed-migration memory_total range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall average memory_total range benchmark and variability category, and whether the instance also appears among the "flare3" instances with display names matching "flare" whose cached network info length is above that group's average. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.

prediction.sql:
WITH prime_instances AS (
  SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.display_name LIKE '%prime%'
),
completed_migrations AS (
  SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.memory_total
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN prime_instances pi ON m.instance_uuid = pi.uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
instance_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    pi.uuid,
    pi.display_name,
    MAX(cm.memory_total) - MIN(cm.memory_total) AS memory_total_range,
    VAR_SAMP(cm.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance,
    STDDEV(cm.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev
  FROM prime_instances pi
  JOIN completed_migrations cm ON pi.uuid = cm.instance_uuid
  GROUP BY pi.uuid, pi.display_name
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_range
  FROM instance_stats
),
flare_network_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(LENGTH(iic.network_info)) AS avg_network_len
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.display_name LIKE '%flare%'
),
flare_above_avg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.uuid
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid
  CROSS JOIN flare_network_avg fna
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.display_name LIKE '%flare%'
    AND LENGTH(iic.network_info) > fna.avg_network_len
)
SELECT

  CASE

  CASE 
    WHEN faa.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS flare_network_above_average

CROSS JOIN benchmark b

ORDER BY ist.display_name

WITH prime AS (
  SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name LIKE '%prime%'
),
mig AS (
  SELECT m.instance_uuid,
         MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS mem_range,
         VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS mem_var,
         STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS mem_std
  FROM migrations m
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY m.instance_uuid
),
bench AS (
  SELECT AVG(r.mem_range) AS avg_range
  FROM (
    SELECT MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS mem_range
    FROM migrations m
    WHERE m.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY m.instance_uuid
  ) r
),
flare AS (
  SELECT i.uuid, LENGTH(c.network_info) AS net_len
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name LIKE '%flare%'
),
flare_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_len) AS avg_len FROM flare
)
SELECT
  p.display_name,
  mig.mem_range,
  mig.mem_var,
  mig.mem_std,
  b.avg_range,
  CASE
    WHEN mig.mem_range >= b.avg_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY'
    WHEN mig.mem_range <= b.avg_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'
  END AS variability_category,
  CASE WHEN f.uuid IS NOT NULL AND f.net_len > fa.avg_len THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_flare_above_avg
FROM prime p
LEFT JOIN mig ON mig.instance_uuid = p.uuid
CROSS JOIN bench b
LEFT JOIN flare f ON f.uuid = p.uuid
CROSS JOIN flare_avg fa
ORDER BY p.display_name;
